settings.text:
At LUXIAOJUN, we create professional-grade gear for those who train with intention


Every product is engineered with strength, stability, and precision at its core, supporting controlled and confident movement at every level.


This is performance refined and progress redefined, one lift at a time.

settings.question: What size should I choose? Do LUXIAOJUN shoes run true to size?
settings.answer: Most customers find the shoes fit true to size, with several reviewers stating they match their usual shoe size perfectly. However, the shoes have a "slim, low volume fit". For the most accurate fit, we recommend measuring your foot (from heel to longest toe) and matching it to our specific size chart, which is available on every product page.

settings.question: What makes LUXIAOJUN shoes different from regular trainers?
settings.answer: Weightlifting shoes like LUXIAOJUN provide a rigid, stable platform and a raised heel to support proper positioning in squats and Olympic lifts. Regular trainers prioritize cushioning and flexibility, which can reduce stability and power transfer when lifting heavy loads. They are specifically engineered to maximize "stability" and "support" for the user.

settings.question: Why are they so popular among professional athletes?
settings.answer: LUXIAOJUN shoes are designed and tested by Olympic Gold Medalist Lu Xiaojun, a three-time Olympic gold medalist. They underwent over two years of research and development before being officially launched, ensuring they meet the highest standards of competition. They are battle-tested at the highest levels of the sport, with athletes like Karlos Nasar using them to shatter world records.

settings.question: Do you offer accessories?
settings.answer: Yes. We offer a range of weightlifting accessories, including belts, lifting straps, and plates to enhance your training experience

settings.question: What is the return policy?
settings.answer:
You have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return. And the shipping cost is on you. To be eligible for a return, your item must: 

  • Be in the same condition that you received it with original tags.
  • Be unworn or unused, otherwise you are liable for depreciation of the products and may receive a partial refund.
  • Include the receipt or proof of purchase
